adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `eventType.destinationCalendar ? [..] : organizerUser.destinationCalendar ? [..] : null` (so it can be `null`). Later, for COLLECTIVE team events, other hosts’ destination calendars are collected into `teamDestinationCalendars`, but they’re only added via `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, the optional-chained `push` is skipped and those other hosts’ calendars are never attached to the event object, so the downstream calendar-creation path that relies on `event.destinationCalendar` being a non-empty array won’t see them.
